title: Property List Changed Webhook
description: Webhook notification sent when a property list's resolved properties change. Contains a summary only - recipients must call get_property_list to retrieve the updated properties. This keeps payloads small and avoids redundant data transfer. Deliveries MUST use the AdCP RFC 9421 webhook profile; property-list webhook registrations do not define a legacy authentication selector.

idempotency_key.description: Sender-generated key stable across retries of the same webhook event. Governance agents MUST generate a cryptographically random value (UUID v4 recommended) per distinct list-change event and reuse the same key on every retry. Recipients MUST dedupe by this key, scoped to the authenticated sender identity established by the RFC 9421 signing key — keys from different governance agents are independent.

list_id.description: ID of the property list that changed

change_summary.description: Summary of changes to the resolved list

properties_added.description: Number of properties added since last resolution

properties_removed.description: Number of properties removed since last resolution

total_properties.description: Total properties in the resolved list

cache_valid_until.description: When the consumer should refresh from the governance agent

signature.description: Deprecated 3.x compatibility field. This value is not an authentication input: RFC 9421 signatures are carried in the Signature and Signature-Input HTTP headers and bind the payload through Content-Digest. Receivers MUST ignore this body value when authenticating a delivery. New senders MUST omit it; the field is removed in 4.0.
